title: SBI Apprentice 2026 - 7,150 Posts, Apply Online Now at sbi.co.in, Last Date June 8
author: Ash K.
summary: State Bank of India has released notification for 7,150 Apprentice posts under Apprentices Act 1961. Apply online from May 19 to June 8, 2026. Any graduate eligible. ₹15,000/month stipend. Selection through online exam + local language test. State-wise vacancies across India.
body: State Bank of India (SBI) has released one of the largest bank apprentice drives of 2026 - 7,150 Apprentice posts across all states and union territories. Applications opened yesterday, May 19.

DetailInformation
Total Posts7,150 Apprentice seats
Advt. No.CRPD/APPR/2026-27/07
Apply StartMay 19, 2026
Last DateJune 8, 2026
EligibilityGraduation in any discipline (no minimum %)
Age20-28 years (as on April 1, 2026)
Stipend₹15,000/month for 1 year
Duration1 year apprenticeship training
SelectionOnline Exam (100 MCQs, 1 hr) + Local Language Test
Negative Marking0.25 marks per wrong answer
Exam SectionsReasoning (15 min) + Quant (15 min) + English (15 min) + GA (15 min)
Exam DateTentatively July 2026
Apply Atsbi.co.in / sbi.bank.in

Key highlights: No minimum percentage required in graduation - any graduate from any discipline can apply. Application can only be made for one state. You must be proficient in the local language of the state you apply for - there's a separate qualifying language test after the written exam.

Exam pattern: Online test with 100 MCQs worth 100 marks in 1 hour. Four sections with 15 minutes each - Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, and General/Financial Awareness. Negative marking of 0.25 per wrong answer. Questions bilingual (English + Hindi) except English section.

What you get: ₹15,000/month fixed stipend during the 1-year training. No DA, HRA, or PF. This is a training program under the Apprentices Act, not permanent employment. But it gives you real branch-level banking experience at India's largest bank.

Why this matters: SBI apprenticeship is widely considered the best entry point for banking careers. You learn core banking operations - account opening, loan processing, cash handling, customer service. This experience significantly boosts your chances in IBPS PO/Clerk and SBI PO exams.

How to apply: Visit sbi.co.in → Careers → Current Openings → SBI Apprentice 2026 → New Registration → Fill details → Upload photo + signature → Pay fee → Submit. Don't wait until June 8 - server crashes are common on the last day.
For banking exam preparation, check our IBPS PO exam guide. For comparison with other government exams, see our Bank PO vs SSC CGL comparison.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for SBI Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is June 8, 2026 at sbi.co.in. Applications opened on May 19, 2026.

faqs.question: What qualification is needed for SBI Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university. No minimum percentage is required.

faqs.question: What is the stipend for SBI Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices receive ₹15,000/month fixed stipend for the 1-year training period. No DA, HRA, or PF benefits.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in SBI Apprentice exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. Unanswered questions carry no penalty.

faqs.question: Can I apply for SBI Apprentice in multiple states?
faqs.answer: No. You can apply for only one state/UT. You must be proficient in the local language of that state.

faqs.question: When is the SBI Apprentice 2026 exam date?
faqs.answer: The online exam is tentatively scheduled for July 2026. Exact date will be notified on sbi.co.in.

callout.heading: No Minimum Percentage Required
callout.content: Unlike most bank recruitments, SBI Apprentice 2026 has no minimum percentage requirement for graduation. If you have a degree from any recognized university in any discipline, you're eligible. Apply now at sbi.co.in.
